translations.idiomatic: Later, when Liu Jin disturbed government, he retrospectively charged that during Cheng's salt inspection he had slightly reduced the revenue quota and compelled his family to make restitution.

sentences.zh: 程死久矣，止遣一孫女。

translations.literal: Cheng had long been dead; only one granddaughter was sent away.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng had long been dead; only one granddaughter remained to be sent away.

sentences.zh: 罄產不足，則並女鬻之，行道皆為流涕。

translations.literal: When their property was exhausted and still insufficient, they even sold the girl as well; travelers on the road all wept for them.
translations.idiomatic: When their property was exhausted and still insufficient, they even sold the girl as well; passersby on the road all wept for them.

sentences.zh: 龐泮，字元化，天臺人。

translations.literal: Pang Pan, styled Yuanhua, native of Tiantai.
translations.idiomatic: Pang Pan, styled Yuanhua, was a native of Tiantai.

sentences.zh: 成化二十年進士。

translations.literal: A presented scholar in the twentieth year of Chenghua.
translations.idiomatic: He became a presented scholar in the twentieth year of Chenghua (1484).

sentences.zh: 授工科給事中。

translations.literal: Appointed supervising secretary of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed supervising secretary of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 弘治中，中旨取善擊銅鼓者，泮疏諫。

translations.literal: In the Hongzhi period an imperial rescript sought those skilled at striking bronze drums; Pan memorialized in remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: During Hongzhi an imperial rescript sought men skilled at striking bronze drums; Pan memorialized in remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 屢遷刑科都給事中。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to chief supervising secretary of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to chief supervising secretary of the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 副使楊茂元被逮，泮率同列救之，茂元得薄譴。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner Yang Maoyuan was arrested; Pan led his colleagues to save him, and Maoyuan received only a light reprimand.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commissioner Yang Maoyuan was arrested; Pan led his colleagues to plead for him, and Maoyuan received only a light reprimand.

sentences.zh: 九年四月，帝以岷王劾武岡知州劉遜，命逮之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the ninth year the emperor, because the Prince of Min memorialized against Prefect Liu Xun of Wugang, ordered him seized.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the ninth year, because the Prince of Min memorialized against Liu Xun, prefect of Wugang, the emperor ordered Liu seized.

sentences.zh: 泮率同官呂獻等言：「錦衣天子視軍，非不軌及妖言重情不可輕遣。

translations.literal: Pan led his colleagues Lü Xian and others in saying: "The Embroidered Uniform Guard serves when the Son of Heaven inspects the army; unless it is sedition or grave charges of heterodox speech they cannot be lightly dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: Pan led his colleagues Lü Xian and others in saying: "The Embroidered Uniform Guard is for when the Son of Heaven inspects the army; unless the case involves sedition or grave charges of heterodox speech, they must not be dispatched lightly.

sentences.zh: 遜所坐微，而王奏牽左證百人，勢難盡逮。

translations.literal: Xun's offense was minor, yet the prince's memorial implicated a hundred persons as left-hand evidence—the situation makes complete arrest difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Xun's offense was minor, yet the prince's memorial implicated a hundred people as corroborating witnesses—complete arrest would be difficult.

sentences.zh: 宜敕撫、按官體勘。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to order the grand coordinators and surveillance commissioners to conduct an integrated inquest."
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinators and surveillance commissioners should be ordered to investigate the matter on site."

sentences.zh: 疏入，忤旨，下泮等四十二人及御史劉紳等二十人詔獄。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered it violated the imperial intent; Pan and forty-two others plus Censor Liu Shen and twenty others were placed in the imperial prison.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted it offended the imperial intent; Pan and forty-two others, together with Censor Liu Shen and twenty others, were placed in the imperial prison.

sentences.zh: 六科署空，吏部尚書屠滽請令中書代收部院封事。

translations.literal: The Six Offices of Scrutiny stood vacant; Minister of Personnel Tu Yong requested that the Secretariat temporarily receive sealed documents from ministries and courts.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Offices of Scrutiny stood vacant; Minister of Personnel Tu Yong asked that the Secretariat temporarily receive sealed memorials from the ministries and courts.

sentences.zh: 御史張淳奉使還，恥獨不與，抗疏論之。

translations.literal: Censor Zhang Chun, returning from a mission, was ashamed to be the only one not included and submitted a defiant memorial arguing against it.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhang Chun, returning from a mission, was ashamed to be the only one left out and submitted a defiant memorial arguing against it.

sentences.zh: 考功郎中儲雚亦諫，滽等復率九卿救之。

translations.literal: Bureau Director Chu Tan also remonstrated; Yong and others again led the Nine Ministers to save them.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau Director Chu Tan also remonstrated; Yong and others again led the Nine Ministers to plead for them.

sentences.zh: 帝乃釋泮等，皆停俸三月。

translations.literal: The emperor then released Pan and the others; all had their salaries suspended for three months.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then released Pan and the others; all had their salaries suspended for three months.

sentences.zh: 中官何鼎以直言下獄，楊鵬、戴禮夤緣入司禮監。

translations.literal: Eunuch He Ding was imprisoned for blunt speech; Yang Peng and Dai Li used connections to enter the Directorate of Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch He Ding was imprisoned for blunt speech; Yang Peng and Dai Li used connections to enter the Directorate of Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 泮等言：「鼎狂直宜容。

translations.literal: Pan and others said: "Ding is wildly blunt and should be tolerated.
translations.idiomatic: Pan and others said: "Ding is wildly blunt and should be tolerated.

sentences.zh: 鵬等得罪先朝，俾參機密，害非小。」

translations.literal: Peng and others offended the former court; appointing them to participate in state secrets—the harm is no small matter."
translations.idiomatic: Peng and others offended the former court; to appoint them to share in state secrets—the harm is no small matter."

sentences.zh: 會御史黃山、張泰等亦以為言。

translations.literal: At the same time Censors Huang Shan and Zhang Tai also spoke on this.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Censors Huang Shan and Zhang Tai also spoke on this.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，詰外廷何由知內廷事，令對狀，停泮等俸半歲。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and questioned how the outer court knew inner-court affairs, ordered them to confront the charges, and suspended Pan and others' salaries for half a year.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry and demanded to know how the outer court learned of inner-court affairs, ordered them to confront the charges in person, and suspended Pan and others' salaries for half a year.

sentences.zh: 威寧伯王越謀起用，中官蔣琮、李廣有罪，外戚周彧、張鶴齡縱家奴殺人，泮皆極論，直聲甚著。

translations.literal: Defender of Weining Wang Yue plotted to be reappointed; eunuchs Jiang Cong and Li Guang were guilty; maternal relatives Zhou Yu and Zhang Heqing let their household slaves murder people—Pan strongly argued against all, and his upright reputation was very pronounced.
translations.idiomatic: Defender of Weining Wang Yue plotted to be reappointed; eunuchs Jiang Cong and Li Guang were guilty; maternal relatives Zhou Yu and Zhang Heqing let their household slaves kill people—Pan strongly argued against every case, and his reputation for blunt integrity was very great.

sentences.zh: 十一年擢福建右參政。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was promoted to Right Administrative Commissioner of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was promoted to Right Administrative Commissioner of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 中官奪宋儒黃幹宅為僧庵，泮改為書院以祀幹。

translations.literal: A eunuch seized the residence of Song Neo-Confucian Huang Gan for a monk's hermitage; Pan converted it into an academy to sacrifice to Gan.
translations.idiomatic: A eunuch seized the residence of the Song Neo-Confucian Huang Gan for a monk's hermitage; Pan converted it into an academy to sacrifice to Gan.

sentences.zh: 遷河南右布政使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Henan.

sentences.zh: 中旨取洛陽牡丹，疏請罷之。

translations.literal: An imperial rescript took Luoyang peonies; he memorialized requesting this be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial rescript demanded Luoyang peonies; he memorialized asking that this be stopped.

sentences.zh: 轉廣西左布政使，致仕。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Left Provincial Administration Commissioner of Guangxi and retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Left Provincial Administration Commissioner of Guangxi and then retired.

sentences.zh: 呂獻，浙江新昌人。

translations.literal: Lü Xian, native of Xinchang in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Xian was a native of Xinchang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 成化二十年進士。

translations.literal: A presented scholar in the twentieth year of Chenghua.
translations.idiomatic: He became a presented scholar in the twentieth year of Chenghua (1484).

sentences.zh: 授刑科給事中。

translations.literal: Appointed supervising secretary of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed supervising secretary of the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 坐事，杖闕廷。

translations.literal: For an offense he was beaten at court in the palace courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: For an offense he was beaten at court in the palace courtyard.

sentences.zh: 弘治時，詔選駙馬。

translations.literal: In the Hongzhi period an edict selected imperial sons-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: During Hongzhi an edict was issued to select imperial sons-in-law.

sentences.zh: 李廣受富人金，陰為地，為獻所發，有直聲。

translations.literal: Li Guang accepted rich men's gold and secretly arranged positions—Xian exposed this, and he had an upright reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guang accepted gold from wealthy men and secretly arranged appointments—Xian exposed this and gained a reputation for integrity.

sentences.zh: 正德中，終南京兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: In the Zhengde period he finally served as Right Vice Minister of War at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhengde period he finally served as Right Vice Minister of War at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 葉紳，字廷縉，吳江人。

translations.literal: Ye Shen, styled Tingjin, native of Wujiang.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Shen, styled Tingjin, was a native of Wujiang.

sentences.zh: 成化末進士。

translations.literal: At the end of the Chenghua reign, jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination at the end of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 除戶科給事中，改吏科，歷禮科左給事中。

translations.literal: He was appointed supervising secretary of the Ministry of Revenue, transferred to the Ministry of Personnel, and successively served as Left supervising secretary of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed supervising secretary of the Ministry of Revenue, transferred to the Ministry of Personnel, and successively served as Left supervising secretary of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 弘治十年，太子年七歲，猶未出閤，紳請擇講官教諭。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Hongzhi the crown prince was seven years old and still had not left the inner quarters; Shen requested selecting lecture officials to instruct and teach him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Hongzhi the crown prince was seven years old and still had not left the inner quarters; Shen asked that lecture officials be selected to instruct him.

sentences.zh: 尋以修省，陳八事。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, on the occasion of cultivation and self-examination, he set forth eight matters.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly thereafter, on the occasion of self-cultivation and reflection, he set forth eight matters.

sentences.zh: 斥中官李廣，又劾尚書徐瓊、童軒、侯瓚，侍郎鄭紀、王宗彜，巡撫都御史劉瓛、張誥、張岫等二十人，乞賜罷斥。

translations.literal: He denounced the eunuch Li Guang and also impeached Ministers Xu Qiong, Tong Xuan, and Hou Zan, Vice Ministers Zheng Ji and Wang Zongyi, and Grand Coordinators and Censors Liu Fan, Zhang Gao, Zhang You, and twenty others in all, begging that they be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He denounced the eunuch Li Guang and also impeached Ministers Xu Qiong, Tong Xuan, and Hou Zan, Vice Ministers Zheng Ji and Wang Zongyi, and Grand Coordinators Liu Fan, Zhang Gao, Zhang You, and twenty others in all, asking that they be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 而末言「去大奸」，則專劾李廣八大罪：「誑陛下以燒煉，而進不經之藥，罪一。

translations.literal: At the end he wrote "Remove the great villain," then devoted the memorial solely to impeaching Li Guang for eight great crimes: "He deceived Your Majesty with alchemical refining and presented unorthodox medicines—crime one.
translations.idiomatic: At the end he wrote "Remove the great villain," then devoted the memorial solely to impeaching Li Guang for eight great crimes: "He deceived Your Majesty with alchemical refining and presented unorthodox medicines—crime one.

sentences.zh: 為太子立寄壇，而興暖疏之說，罪二。

translations.literal: He set up a surrogate altar for the crown prince and promoted the doctrine of "warm and sparse"—crime two.
translations.idiomatic: He set up a surrogate altar for the crown prince and promoted the doctrine of warm and sparse fertility rites—crime two.

sentences.zh: 撥置皇親，希求恩寵，罪三。

translations.literal: He arranged placements for imperial kin and sought favor and grace—crime three.
translations.idiomatic: He arranged placements for imperial kin and sought favor and patronage—crime three.

sentences.zh: 盜引玉泉，經繞私第，罪四。

translations.literal: He stole the Jade Spring channel to wind around his private residence—crime four.
translations.idiomatic: He diverted the Jade Spring to wind around his private residence—crime four.

sentences.zh: 首開幸門，大肆奸貪，罪五。

translations.literal: He was the first to open the gate of imperial favor and carried out great fraud and greed—crime five.
translations.idiomatic: He was the first to open the gate of imperial favor and carried out great fraud and greed—crime five.

sentences.zh: 太常崔誌端、真人王應裿輩稱廣為教主真人，廣即代求善官，乞賜玉帶，罪六。

translations.literal: Director of Ceremonies Cui Zhiduan and Perfected Man Wang Yingyi and their like called Guang "Cult Leader Perfected Man," and Guang at once sought good offices on their behalf and begged the gift of a jade belt—crime six.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Ceremonies Cui Zhiduan and Perfected Man Wang Yingyi and their like called Guang Cult Leader Perfected Man, and Guang at once sought good offices on their behalf and begged the gift of a jade belt—crime six.

sentences.zh: 假果戶為名，侵奪畿民土地，幾至激變，罪七。

translations.literal: Under the name of fruit households he seized capital-region commoners' land and nearly incited open disturbance—crime seven.
translations.idiomatic: Under the name of fruit households he seized commoners' land in the capital region and nearly incited open disturbance—crime seven.

sentences.zh: 四方輸納上供，威取勢逼，致民破產，罪八。

translations.literal: Tribute sent in from the four directions he took by force and coercion, driving the people to ruin—crime eight.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute sent in from the four directions he took by force and coercion, driving the people to ruin—crime eight.

sentences.zh: 內而皇親駙馬事之如父，外而總兵鎮守稱之為公。

translations.literal: Within, imperial sons-in-law and consorts treated him like a father; without, regional commanders and garrison eunuchs called him "Lord."
translations.idiomatic: Within, imperial sons-in-law and consorts treated him like a father; without, regional commanders and garrison eunuchs called him Lord.

sentences.zh: 陛下奈何養此大奸於肘腋，而不思驅斥哉！」

translations.literal: How can Your Majesty nurture this great villain at your very elbow and not think to drive him out!"
translations.idiomatic: How can Your Majesty nurture this great villain at your very elbow and not think to drive him out!"

sentences.zh: 御史張縉等亦以為言。

translations.literal: Censor Zhang Jin and others also spoke on this.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Zhang Jin and others also spoke on this.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「姑置之。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "For the present, set it aside."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "For the present, set it aside."

sentences.zh: 逾數月，廣竟得罪飲冘死。

translations.literal: After several months Guang at last met with guilt and died from drinking poison.
translations.idiomatic: After several months Guang at last met with guilt and died from drinking poison.

sentences.zh: 紳又極陳大臣恩蔭葬祭之濫。

translations.literal: Shen also strongly set forth the abuses of ministers' grace-inheritance burials and sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Shen also strongly set forth the abuses of ministers' grace-inheritance burials and sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 下所司議，頗有減損。

translations.literal: The matter was sent down to the responsible offices for discussion, and there was considerable reduction.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was sent down to the responsible offices for discussion, and there was considerable reduction.

sentences.zh: 擢尚寶少卿，卒。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Imperial Treasures and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Imperial Treasures and died.

sentences.zh: 胡獻，字時臣，揚州興化人。

translations.literal: Hu Xian, styled Shichen, was a native of Xinghua in Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Xian, styled Shichen, was a native of Xinghua in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 弘治九年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the ninth year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the ninth year of Hongzhi.

sentences.zh: 改庶吉士，授御史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Hanlin Bachelor and appointed censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Hanlin Bachelor and appointed censor.

sentences.zh: 逾月，即極論時政數事，言：「屠滽為吏部尚書，王越、李蕙為都御史，皆交通中官李廣得之。

translations.literal: Within a month he vigorously discussed several matters of current policy, saying: "Tu Fu as Minister of Personnel, Wang Yue and Li Hui as Censors-in-Chief—all obtained their posts through dealings with the eunuch Li Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Within a month he vigorously discussed several matters of current policy, saying: "Tu Fu as Minister of Personnel, Wang Yue and Li Hui as Censors-in-Chief—all obtained their posts through dealings with the eunuch Li Guang.

sentences.zh: 廣得售奸，由陛下議政不任大臣，而任廣輩也。

translations.literal: Guang could practice villainy because Your Majesty deliberates on government without trusting great ministers but trusts Guang and his like.
translations.idiomatic: Guang could practice villainy because Your Majesty deliberates on government without trusting great ministers but trusts Guang and his like.

sentences.zh: 祖宗時，恒禦內閣商決章奏，經筵日講悉陳時政得失，又不時接見儒臣，願陛下追復舊制。

translations.literal: In ancestral times the emperor regularly attended the Grand Secretariat to decide on memorials; the daily lecture sessions fully set forth the gains and losses of current policy; and from time to time he received Confucian ministers—I beg Your Majesty to restore the old system.
translations.idiomatic: In ancestral times the emperor regularly attended the Grand Secretariat to decide on memorials; the daily lecture sessions fully set forth the gains and losses of current policy; and from time to time he received Confucian ministers—I beg Your Majesty to restore the old system.

sentences.zh: 京、通二倉總督、監督內臣，每收米萬石勒白金十兩。

translations.literal: Eunuchs supervising the Beijing and Tongzhou granaries, for every ten thousand shi of grain received extorted ten taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs supervising the Beijing and Tongzhou granaries, for every ten thousand shi of grain received extorted ten taels of white silver.

sentences.zh: 以歲運四百萬石計之，人四千兩。

translations.literal: Calculated on four million shi of annual transport, that is four thousand taels per man.
translations.idiomatic: Calculated on four million shi of annual transport, that is four thousand taels per man.

sentences.zh: 又各占鬥級二三百人，使納月錢。

translations.literal: They also each took two or three hundred grain-scale clerks and made them pay monthly fees.
translations.idiomatic: They also each took two or three hundred grain-scale clerks and made them pay monthly fees.

sentences.zh: 夫監督倉儲，自有戶部，焉用中官？

translations.literal: Supervision of granaries properly belongs to the Ministry of Revenue—what need is there for eunuchs?
translations.idiomatic: Supervision of granaries properly belongs to the Ministry of Revenue—what need is there for eunuchs?

sentences.zh: 願賜罷遣。

translations.literal: I beg that they be dismissed and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that they be dismissed and sent away.

sentences.zh: 京操軍士自數千里至，而總兵、坐營等官各使分屬辦納月錢，乞嚴革以蘇其困。

translations.literal: Capital-garrison soldiers come from thousands of li away, yet regional commanders, camp commanders, and other officers each make their subordinates collect monthly fees—I beg strict reform to relieve their distress.
translations.idiomatic: Capital-garrison soldiers come from thousands of li away, yet regional commanders, camp commanders, and other officers each make their subordinates collect monthly fees—I beg strict reform to relieve their distress.

sentences.zh: 陛下遇災修省，去春求言，諫官及郎中王雲鳳、主事胡爟皆有論奏，留中不報，雲鳳尋得罪。

translations.literal: Your Majesty, encountering calamity, undertook cultivation and self-examination; last spring you sought remonstrance, and remonstrance officials together with Bureau Director Wang Yunfeng and Section Director Hu Ran all submitted discussion—but the memorials were retained at court without response, and Yunfeng soon met with punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, encountering calamity, undertook self-cultivation and reflection; last spring you sought remonstrance, and remonstrance officials together with Bureau Director Wang Yunfeng and Section Director Hu Ran all submitted discussion—but the memorials were retained at court without response, and Yunfeng soon met with punishment.

sentences.zh: 如此，則與不修省何異？

translations.literal: If so, how is this different from not undertaking self-examination at all?
translations.idiomatic: If so, how is this different from not undertaking self-examination at all?

sentences.zh: 願斷自聖心，凡利弊當興革者，即見施行。

translations.literal: I beg Your Majesty to decide from your sacred mind: whatever benefit or harm ought to be instituted or abolished, let it be carried out at once.
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to decide from your sacred mind: whatever benefit or harm ought to be instituted or abolished, let it be carried out at once.

sentences.zh: 東廠校尉，本以緝奸，邇者但為內戚、中官泄憤報怨。

translations.literal: Eastern Depot guards were originally to apprehend villains, but recently they serve only to vent the anger and avenge the grudges of inner kin and eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Depot guards were originally to apprehend villains, but recently they serve only to vent the anger and avenge the grudges of inner kin and eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 如御史武衢忤壽寧侯張鶴齡及太監楊鵬，主事毛廣忤太監韋泰，皆為校尉所發，推求細事，誣以罪名。

translations.literal: For example, Censor Wu Heng offended the Marquis of Shouning Zhang Heqing and Eunuch Yang Peng; Section Director Mao Guang offended Eunuch Wei Tai—all were exposed by depot guards, who pursued minute matters and framed charges against them.
translations.idiomatic: For example, Censor Wu Heng offended the Marquis of Shouning Zhang Heqing and Eunuch Yang Peng; Section Director Mao Guang offended Eunuch Wei Tai—all were exposed by depot guards, who pursued minute matters and framed charges against them.

sentences.zh: 舉朝皆知其枉，無敢言者。

translations.literal: The whole court knew they were wronged, yet none dared speak.
translations.idiomatic: The whole court knew they were wronged, yet none dared speak.

sentences.zh: 臣亦知今日言之，異日必為所陷，然臣弗懼也。」

translations.literal: Your servant also knows that to speak today is to be framed by them on another day—yet your servant is not afraid."
translations.idiomatic: Your servant also knows that to speak today is to be framed by them on another day—yet your servant is not afraid."

sentences.zh: 疏入，鶴齡與泰各疏辨。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, Heqing and Tai each submitted memorials in defense.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial entered, Heqing and Tai each submitted memorials in defense.

sentences.zh: 會給事中胡易劾監庫中官賀彬貪黷八罪，彬亦訐易。

translations.literal: At the same time Supervising Secretary Hu Yi impeached the granary eunuch He Bin for eight crimes of corruption and dereliction, and Bin also accused Yi.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Supervising Secretary Hu Yi impeached the granary eunuch He Bin for eight crimes of corruption and dereliction, and Bin also accused Yi.

sentences.zh: 帝遂下獻、易詔獄，謫獻藍山丞。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon sent Xian and Yi to the imperial prison and demoted Xian to Assistant Magistrate of Lanshan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon sent Xian and Yi to the imperial prison and demoted Xian to Assistant Magistrate of Lanshan.

sentences.zh: 久之，釋易。

translations.literal: After a long while Yi was released.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while Yi was released.

sentences.zh: 獻未赴官，遷宜陽知縣。

translations.literal: Xian had not yet taken up his post when he was transferred to Magistrate of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Xian had not yet taken up his post when he was transferred to Magistrate of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 馬文升數薦於朝，遷南都察院經歷。

translations.literal: Ma Wensheng repeatedly recommended him at court, and he was transferred to Secretary of the Nanjing Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Wensheng repeatedly recommended him at court, and he was transferred to Secretary of the Nanjing Censorate.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位，擢廣西提學僉事，遷福建提學副使，未任卒。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wuzong took the throne he was promoted to Assistant Regional Inspector of Education in Guangxi, transferred to Vice Regional Inspector of Education in Fujian, and died before taking office.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wuzong took the throne he was promoted to Assistant Regional Inspector of Education in Guangxi, transferred to Vice Regional Inspector of Education in Fujian, and died before taking office.

sentences.zh: 武衢，沂水人，成化二十年進士，以御史謫雲南通海主簿，終汾州知州。

translations.literal: Wu Heng, a native of Yishui, jinshi in the twentieth year of Chenghua, was demoted from censor to Registrar of Tonghai in Yunnan and finally served as Magistrate of Fenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Heng, a native of Yishui, jinshi in the twentieth year of Chenghua, was demoted from censor to Registrar of Tonghai in Yunnan and finally served as Magistrate of Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 毛廣，平湖人。

translations.literal: Mao Guang, a native of Pinghu.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Guang was a native of Pinghu.

sentences.zh: 成化二十年進士。

translations.literal: A presented scholar in the twentieth year of Chenghua.
translations.idiomatic: He became a presented scholar in the twentieth year of Chenghua (1484).

sentences.zh: 其事跡無考。

translations.literal: His deeds cannot be verified.
translations.idiomatic: His deeds cannot be verified.

sentences.zh: 胡易，寧都人。

translations.literal: Hu Yi, a native of Ningdu.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yi was a native of Ningdu.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the third year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the third year of Hongzhi.

sentences.zh: 為吏科給事中。

translations.literal: He served as supervising secretary of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He served as supervising secretary of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 華昶劾程敏政，法司白昂、閔珪據舊章令六科共鞫。

translations.literal: Hua Chang impeached Cheng Minzheng; the judicial offices Bai Ang and Min Gui, according to old regulations, ordered the Six Offices jointly to interrogate.
translations.idiomatic: Hua Chang impeached Cheng Minzheng; the judicial offices Bai Ang and Min Gui, according to old regulations, ordered the Six Offices jointly to interrogate.

sentences.zh: 東廠劾易等皆昶同僚，不當與訊。

translations.literal: The Eastern Depot impeached Yi and others as all being Chang's colleagues and unfit to join the inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Depot impeached Yi and others as all being Chang's colleagues and unfit to join the inquiry.

sentences.zh: 得旨下詔獄。

translations.literal: An edict was received sending them to the imperial prison.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was received sending them to the imperial prison.

sentences.zh: 昂、珪請罪，皆停俸。

translations.literal: Ang and Gui begged punishment; all had their salaries suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Ang and Gui begged punishment; all had their salaries suspended.

sentences.zh: 比昶獄成，易等猶被系，大臣以為言，始令復職。

translations.literal: By the time Chang's case was concluded Yi and others were still detained; great ministers spoke on their behalf, and only then were they ordered to resume office.
translations.idiomatic: By the time Chang's case was concluded Yi and others were still detained; great ministers spoke on their behalf, and only then were they ordered to resume office.

sentences.zh: 當弘治時，言官以忤內臣得罪者，又有任儀、車梁。

translations.literal: During Hongzhi, remonstrance officials who offended eunuchs and met with punishment included also Ren Yi and Che Liang.
translations.idiomatic: During Hongzhi, remonstrance officials who offended eunuchs and met with punishment included also Ren Yi and Che Liang.

sentences.zh: 任儀，閬中人。

translations.literal: Ren Yi, a native of Langzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Yi was a native of Langzhong.

sentences.zh: 成化二十三年進士，為御史。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the twenty-third year of Chenghua; he served as censor.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the twenty-third year of Chenghua and served as censor.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年秋，詔修齋於大興隆寺。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the third year of Hongzhi an edict ordered fasting rituals at the Great Xinglong Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the third year of Hongzhi an edict ordered fasting rituals at the Great Xinglong Temple.

sentences.zh: 理刑知縣王嶽騎過之，中使捽辱嶽，使跪於寺前。

translations.literal: Magistrate for criminal adjudication Wang Yue rode past it; an inner eunuch seized and humiliated Yue and made him kneel before the temple.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate for criminal adjudication Wang Yue rode past it; an inner eunuch seized and humiliated Yue and made him kneel before the temple.

sentences.zh: 儀不平，劾中使罪。

translations.literal: Yi was indignant and impeached the eunuch's crime.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was indignant and impeached the eunuch's crime.

sentences.zh: 姓名偶誤，乃並儀下吏。

translations.literal: A name was accidentally wrong, and Yi was sent down to the officials together with the error.
translations.idiomatic: A name was accidentally wrong, and Yi was sent down to the officials together with the error.

sentences.zh: 出為中部知縣，終山西參政。

translations.literal: He was sent out as Magistrate of Zhongbu and finally served as Administrative Commissioner of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as Magistrate of Zhongbu and finally served as Administrative Commissioner of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 車梁，山西永寧人。

translations.literal: Che Liang, a native of Yongning in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Che Liang was a native of Yongning in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年進士，為御史。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the third year of Hongzhi; he served as censor.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the third year of Hongzhi and served as censor.

sentences.zh: 十五年條列時政，中言東廠錦衣衛所獲盜，先嚴刑具成案，然後送法司，法司不敢平反。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he itemized current policy, among which he said that thieves captured by the Eastern Depot and the Embroidered-Uniform Guard were first subjected to severe torture until the case record was complete, and only then sent to the judicial offices, which dared not overturn the verdict.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he itemized current policy, among which he said that thieves captured by the Eastern Depot and the Embroidered-Uniform Guard were first subjected to severe torture until the case record was complete, and only then sent to the judicial offices, which dared not overturn the verdict.

sentences.zh: 請自今徑送法司，毋先刑訊。

translations.literal: He requested that from now on they be sent directly to the judicial offices without prior torture for confession.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that from now on they be sent directly to the judicial offices without prior torture for confession.

sentences.zh: 章下，未報。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down; there was no response.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was sent down; there was no response.

sentences.zh: 主東廠者言梁從父郎中霆先以罪為東廠所發，挾私妄言，遂下梁詔獄。

translations.literal: The head of the Eastern Depot said Liang's uncle by marriage, Bureau Director Ting, had earlier been exposed by the depot for a crime and was speaking from private grudge with reckless words, and Liang was sent to the imperial prison.
translations.idiomatic: The head of the Eastern Depot said Liang's uncle by marriage, Bureau Director Ting, had earlier been exposed by the depot for a crime and was speaking from private grudge with reckless words, and Liang was sent to the imperial prison.

sentences.zh: 給事御史交章論救，乃得釋，終漢陽知府。

translations.literal: Supervising secretaries and censors jointly memorialized in rescue, and he was released; he finally served as Prefect of Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretaries and censors jointly memorialized in rescue, and he was released; he finally served as Prefect of Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 張弘至，字時行，華亭人，南安知府弼子也。

translations.literal: Zhang Hongzhi, styled Shixing, was a native of Huating and son of Prefect of Nan'an Zhang Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hongzhi, styled Shixing, was a native of Huating and son of Prefect of Nan'an Zhang Bi.

sentences.zh: 舉弘治九年進士，改庶吉士，授兵科給事中。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the ninth year of Hongzhi, was transferred to Hanlin Bachelor, and appointed supervising secretary of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the ninth year of Hongzhi, was transferred to Hanlin Bachelor, and appointed supervising secretary of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 十二年冬，陳初政漸不克終八事：「初汰傳奉官殆盡；

translations.literal: In the winter of the twelfth year he set forth eight matters in which the early policies gradually could not be carried through to the end: "At first relay-appointment officials were nearly all eliminated;
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the twelfth year he set forth eight matters in which the early policies gradually could not be carried through to the end: "At first relay-appointment officials were nearly all eliminated;

sentences.zh: 近匠官張廣寧等一傳至百二十余人，少卿李綸、指揮張玘等再傳至百八十余人。

translations.literal: recently artisan officials such as Zhang Guangning in one relay reached more than one hundred twenty persons, and Vice Director Li Lun and Commander Zhang Qi in a second relay reached more than one hundred eighty persons.
translations.idiomatic: recently artisan officials such as Zhang Guangning in one relay reached more than one hundred twenty persons, and Vice Director Li Lun and Commander Zhang Qi in a second relay reached more than one hundred eighty persons.

sentences.zh: 異初政者一。

translations.literal: This differs from the early policy—one.
translations.idiomatic: This differs from the early policy—one.

sentences.zh: 初追戮繼曉，逐番僧、佛子；

translations.literal: At first Jixiao was pursued and punished and Buddhist monks and Buddha-sons were driven out;
translations.idiomatic: At first Jixiao was pursued and punished and Buddhist monks and Buddha-sons were driven out;

sentences.zh: 近齋醮不息。

translations.literal: recently fasting rituals have not ceased.
translations.idiomatic: recently fasting rituals have not ceased.

sentences.zh: 異初政者二。

translations.literal: This differs from the early policy—two.
translations.idiomatic: This differs from the early policy—two.

sentences.zh: 初去萬安、李裕輩，朝彈夕斥；

translations.literal: At first Wan An, Li Yu, and their like were removed; morning impeachment, evening dismissal;
translations.idiomatic: At first Wan An, Li Yu, and their like were removed; morning impeachment, evening dismissal;

sentences.zh: 近被劾數十疏，如尚書徐瓊者猶居位。

translations.literal: recently on dozens of impeaching memorials, men such as Minister Xu Qiong still hold office.
translations.idiomatic: recently on dozens of impeaching memorials, men such as Minister Xu Qiong still hold office.

sentences.zh: 異初政者三。

translations.literal: This differs from the early policy—three.
translations.idiomatic: This differs from the early policy—three.

sentences.zh: 初聖諭有大政召大臣面議；

translations.literal: At first a sacred instruction said that on great affairs ministers were to be summoned for face-to-face discussion;
translations.idiomatic: At first a sacred instruction said that on great affairs ministers were to be summoned for face-to-face discussion;

sentences.zh: 近上下否隔。

translations.literal: recently above and below are blocked and separated.
translations.idiomatic: recently above and below are blocked and separated.

sentences.zh: 異初政者四。

translations.literal: This differs from the early policy—four.
translations.idiomatic: This differs from the early policy—four.

sentences.zh: 初撤增設內官；

translations.literal: At first additionally appointed inner eunuchs were withdrawn;
translations.idiomatic: At first additionally appointed inner eunuchs were withdrawn;

sentences.zh: 近已還者復去，已革者復增。

translations.literal: recently those already returned have again gone, and those already abolished have again been increased.
translations.idiomatic: recently those already returned have again gone, and those already abolished have again been increased.

sentences.zh: 異初政者五。

translations.literal: This differs from the early policy—five.
translations.idiomatic: This differs from the early policy—five.

sentences.zh: 初慎重詔旨，左右不敢妄幹；

translations.literal: At first edicts and instructions were treated with care, and those at the emperor's side did not dare meddle rashly;
translations.idiomatic: At first edicts and instructions were treated with care, and those at the emperor's side did not dare meddle rashly;

sentences.zh: 近陳情乞恩率俞允。

translations.literal: recently pleas stating circumstances and begging grace are invariably approved.
translations.idiomatic: recently pleas stating circumstances and begging grace are invariably approved.

sentences.zh: 異初政者六。

translations.literal: This differs from the early policy—six.
translations.idiomatic: This differs from the early policy—six.

sentences.zh: 初令兵部申舊章，有妄乞升武職者奏治；

translations.literal: At first the Ministry of War was ordered to cite old regulations: anyone rashly begging promotion in military office was to be memorialized and punished;
translations.idiomatic: At first the Ministry of War was ordered to cite old regulations: anyone rashly begging promotion in military office was to be memorialized and punished;

sentences.zh: 近乞升無違拒。

translations.literal: recently such pleas are never refused.
translations.idiomatic: recently such pleas are never refused.

sentences.zh: 異初政者七。

translations.literal: This differs from the early policy—seven.
translations.idiomatic: This differs from the early policy—seven.

sentences.zh: 初節光祿供億；

translations.literal: At first supplies from the Director of Imperial Regalia were restrained;
translations.idiomatic: At first supplies from the Director of Imperial Regalia were restrained;

sentences.zh: 近冗食日繁，移太倉銀賒市廛物。

translations.literal: recently superfluous eaters grow daily more numerous, and silver from the Grand Storehouse is moved to buy market goods on credit.
translations.idiomatic: recently superfluous eaters grow daily more numerous, and silver from the Grand Storehouse is moved to buy market goods on credit.

sentences.zh: 異初政者八。」

translations.literal: This differs from the early policy—eight."
translations.idiomatic: This differs from the early policy—eight."

sentences.zh: 帝下所司。

translations.literal: The emperor sent it down to the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent it down to the responsible offices.

sentences.zh: 邊將王杲、馬昇、秦恭、陳瑛失機論死，久系。

translations.literal: Border generals Wang Gao, Ma Sheng, Qin Gong, and Chen Ying, having lost their opportunity, were sentenced to death and long detained.
translations.idiomatic: Border generals Wang Gao, Ma Sheng, Qin Gong, and Chen Ying, having lost their opportunity, were sentenced to death and long detained.

sentences.zh: 弘至請速正典刑。

translations.literal: Zhang Hongzhi begged that canonical punishment be quickly applied.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hongzhi asked that canonical punishment be applied at once.

sentences.zh: 親王之藩者，所次舍率營⒎殿，並從官幕次，俱飾絨毯、錦帛，因弘至言多減省。

translations.literal: When princes went to their fiefs, their lodging places invariably built ⒎ halls, and attendants' quarters too were all adorned with velvet rugs and brocade silks; because of Hongzhi's words much was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: When princes went to their fiefs, their lodging places invariably built hall and temple structures, and attendants' quarters too were all adorned with velvet rugs and brocade silks; because of Hongzhi's words much was reduced.

sentences.zh: 孝宗晚年，從廷臣請，遣官核騰驤四衛虛冒弊，以太監寧瑾言而止。

translations.literal: In Xiaozong's later years, following court ministers' request, officials were dispatched to audit phantom-enrollment abuses in the Tengxiang Four Guards; on the eunuch Ning Jin's word it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years Emperor Xiaozong, acceding to court ministers, sent officials to audit the phantom rolls of the Tengxiang Four Guards; the effort was halted on the advice of the eunuch Ning Jin.

sentences.zh: 弘至抗章爭，會兵部亦以為言，乃卒核之。

translations.literal: Hongzhi submitted opposing memorials; when the Ministry of War also spoke on it, they finally carried out the audit.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hongzhi memorialized in protest; when the Ministry of War joined in, the audit was at last carried out.

sentences.zh: 武宗立，以戶科右給事中奉使安南。

translations.literal: When Wuzong acceded, as Right Supervising Secretary of the Revenue Section he was sent on mission to Annan.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wuzong took the throne, he was dispatched to Annan as Right Supervising Secretary of the Revenue Section.

sentences.zh: 還遷都給事中，母憂歸卒。

translations.literal: On return he was promoted to supervising secretary of the capital; he returned home on mother's mourning and died there.
translations.idiomatic: After his return he was promoted to capital supervising secretary; he went home for mourning his mother and died there.

sentences.zh: 屈伸，字引之，任丘人。

translations.literal: Qu Shen, styled Yinzhi, was a native of Renqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Qu Shen, styled Yinzhi, came from Renqiu.

sentences.zh: 成化末進士。

translations.literal: At the end of the Chenghua reign, jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination at the end of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 選庶吉士，授禮科給事中。

translations.literal: Selected as Hanlin Bachelor, appointed supervising secretary of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Chosen as a Hanlin Bachelor, he was appointed supervising secretary of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 弘治九年詔度僧，禮部爭不得。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Hongzhi an edict ordered ordination of monks; the Ministry of Rites argued without success.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Hongzhi an edict called for ordaining monks; the Ministry of Rites objected in vain.

sentences.zh: 伸極陳三不可，不納。

translations.literal: Shen set forth with utmost force three things that must not be; it was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Shen argued at length for three reasons the policy must not proceed; the court would not hear him.

sentences.zh: 京師民訛言寇近邊，兵部請榜諭。

translations.literal: The people of the capital spread rumors that bandits were near the border; the Ministry of War asked to post reassuring proclamations.
translations.idiomatic: Rumors spread through the capital that raiders were near the frontier; the Ministry of War asked to post placards of reassurance.

sentences.zh: 伸言：「若榜示，人心愈驚。

translations.literal: Shen said: "If proclamations are posted, popular hearts will grow only more alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: Shen said: "If we post notices, the people will only grow more frightened.

sentences.zh: 昔漢建始中，都人訛言大水至，議令吏民上城避之。

translations.literal: In former Han, in the Jianshi period, the capital folk spread rumors that a great flood was coming, and there was discussion of ordering officials and people to ascend the walls to flee.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jianshi era of Han, the capital was rife with rumors of a great flood, and officials debated ordering everyone up onto the walls to escape.

sentences.zh: 王商不從，頃之果定。

translations.literal: Wang Shang would not agree; before long things indeed settled.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shang refused; soon enough calm returned.

sentences.zh: 今當以為法。」

translations.literal: Today we ought to take that as our model."
translations.idiomatic: We should do the same now."

sentences.zh: 事遂寢。

translations.literal: The matter was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was abandoned.

sentences.zh: 寇犯大同，遊擊王杲匿敗績狀。

translations.literal: When bandits invaded Datong, guerrilla Wang Gao concealed the facts of defeat.
translations.idiomatic: When raiders struck Datong, the guerrilla officer Wang Gao hid his defeat.

sentences.zh: 伸率同官發之，並劾罪總兵官王璽等。

translations.literal: Shen led his colleagues in exposing it and jointly impeached Regional Commander Wang Xi and others.
translations.idiomatic: Shen led his fellow remonstrators in exposing the fraud and jointly impeached the regional commander Wang Xi and others.

sentences.zh: 屢遷兵科都給事中。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to chief supervising secretary of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through several posts to chief supervising secretary of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 泰寧衛部長大掠遼陽，部議令守臣遺書，稱朝廷寬大不究已往，若還所掠，則予重賞。

translations.literal: A chief of the Taining Guard greatly plundered Liaoyang; the ministry deliberated ordering frontier officials to send a letter saying the court was magnanimous and would not pursue the past, and if they returned what was looted, they would be given rich rewards.
translations.idiomatic: A Taining Guard chieftain raided Liaoyang on a great scale; the ministry proposed that frontier officials send a letter promising imperial magnanimity and no reckoning for past deeds, with rich rewards if the booty were returned.

sentences.zh: 伸等言：「在我示怯弱之形，在彼無創艾之意，非王者威攘之道。

translations.literal: Shen and others said: "On our side we show a shape of timidity and weakness; on theirs there is no sense of being punished and corrected—this is not the kingly way of awe and expulsion.
translations.idiomatic: Shen and his colleagues wrote: "We would show weakness before them, and they would feel no corrective punishment—this is not how a sovereign awes and drives off enemies.

sentences.zh: 前日犯邊不以為罪，今日歸俘反以為功。

translations.literal: The day before border violation was not treated as crime; today returning captives is instead treated as merit.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday a border raid went unpunished; today returning captives is hailed as merit.

sentences.zh: 誨以為盜之利，啟無賴心，又非王者懷柔之道。」

translations.literal: To teach them the profit of brigandage and open the hearts of the unruly is again not the kingly way of gentle assimilation."
translations.idiomatic: To teach them that robbery pays and to stir up the lawless is no kingly policy of winning men by kindness."

sentences.zh: 帝悟，書不果遣。

translations.literal: The emperor took the point; the letter was not in the end sent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor saw the force of the argument, and the letter was never sent.

sentences.zh: 已，劾鎮守中官孫振、總兵官蔣驥、巡撫陳瑤僨事罪，帝不問。

translations.literal: Thereafter he impeached the defending eunuch Sun Zhen, Regional Commander Jiang Ji, and Grand Coordinator Chen Yao for blunder-crimes; the emperor did not inquire.
translations.idiomatic: He later impeached the garrison eunuch Sun Zhen, regional commander Jiang Ji, and grand coordinator Chen Yao for dereliction; the emperor took no action.

sentences.zh: 廣寧復失事，瑤等以捷聞。

translations.literal: Guangning again suffered a setback, and Yao and others reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangning suffered another defeat, Yao and his fellows reported a victory.

sentences.zh: 伸及御史耿明等交章劾其欺罔，乃按治之。

translations.literal: Shen and Censor Geng Ming and others submitted joint memorials charging deception; then they were prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: Shen, Censor Geng Ming, and others filed joint memorials accusing them of fraud, and an investigation followed.

sentences.zh: 太監苗逵、成國公朱暉等搗巢獲三級，及寇大入固原，不敢救，既而斬獲十二級。

translations.literal: Eunuch Miao Kui, Duke of Cheng Zhu Hui and others in a nest-raid obtained three heads; when bandits greatly entered Guyuan they did not dare rescue, yet later beheaded and seized twelve heads.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Miao Kui, the Duke of Cheng Zhu Hui, and others took three heads in a raid on the enemy's nest; when the raiders poured into Guyuan they dared not relieve the city, yet later claimed twelve more heads.

sentences.zh: 先後以捷聞。

translations.literal: Successively they reported victories.
translations.idiomatic: They reported victory again and again.

sentences.zh: 伸等數劾之。

translations.literal: Shen and others repeatedly impeached them.
translations.idiomatic: Shen and his colleagues impeached them repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 及班師，又極論曰：「暉等西討無功，班師命甫下，將士已入國門，不知奉何詔書。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he argued at greatest length: "Hui and others' western campaign had no merit; the order to withdraw had just been issued when officers and soldiers had already entered the capital gates—what edict did they follow?
translations.idiomatic: When the troops came home he argued at length: "Zhu Hui and the rest achieved nothing on the western campaign; the withdrawal order had scarcely been issued when the soldiers were already inside the capital gates—what command were they obeying?

sentences.zh: 且此一役糜京帑及邊儲共一百六十余萬兩，而首功止三級。

translations.literal: Moreover this one campaign consumed more than 1.6 million taels of the capital treasury and frontier stores together, while the chief merit was only three heads.
translations.idiomatic: This single expedition devoured more than 1.6 million taels from the capital treasury and frontier granaries, yet the leading claim was only three heads.

sentences.zh: 是以五十萬金易一無名之首也，乃所上有功將士至萬余人。

translations.literal: That is to exchange five hundred thousand in gold for one nameless head—yet the meritorious officers and soldiers they submitted numbered more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: That is five hundred thousand taels of gold for one anonymous skull—while the roll of meritorious officers and soldiers they submitted ran to more than ten thousand names.

sentences.zh: 假使馘一渠魁如火篩，或斬級至千百，將竭天下財不足供費，而報功者不知幾萬萬也。

translations.literal: If one decapitated one chieftain like Huosai, or cut heads to the hundreds or thousands, the empire's wealth would not suffice for expenses, and those reporting merit would be countless myriads.
translations.idiomatic: Had they taken the head of a chieftain like Huosai, or tallied hundreds or thousands of kills, the empire's wealth could not cover the cost, and the rolls of merit would run to untold myriads.

sentences.zh: 暉、逵及都御史史琳、監軍御史王用宜悉置重典。」

translations.literal: Hui, Kui, and Grand Coordinator Shi Lin and supervising censor Wang Yongyi should all be given heavy penalties."
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hui, Miao Kui, Grand Coordinator Shi Lin, and supervising censor Wang Yongyi should all face severe punishment."

sentences.zh: 帝不聽。

translations.literal: The emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor would not heed them.

sentences.zh: 雲南有鎮守中官，復遣監丞孫敘鎮金騰，伸等極言不可。

translations.literal: Yunnan had a defending eunuch; they again sent Assistant Supervisor Sun Xu to command Jinteng—Shen and others said with utmost force this could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan already had a garrison eunuch, yet the court again sent Assistant Supervisor Sun Xu to command Jinteng; Shen and his colleagues protested in the strongest terms.

sentences.zh: 錦衣指揮孫鑾坐罪閑住，中旨復之，令掌南鎮撫事。

translations.literal: Brocade Guard Commander Sun Luan, convicted and idling, was restored by imperial rescript and ordered to handle southern commissioner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Brocade Guard Commander Sun Luan, dismissed for crime and living in retirement, was restored by imperial rescript and put in charge of the southern commissioner's office.

sentences.zh: 伸等力爭，乃命止帶俸。

translations.literal: Shen and others struggled hard; then he was ordered salary only without office.
translations.idiomatic: Shen and his colleagues fought the appointment; in the end Sun Luan was allowed only his stipend, without duties.

sentences.zh: 中旨令指揮胡震分守天津，伸力爭，不聽。

translations.literal: An imperial rescript ordered Commander Hu Zhen to divide guard at Tianjin; Shen struggled hard but was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial rescript ordered Commander Hu Zhen to take divided command at Tianjin; Shen protested vigorously, but in vain.

sentences.zh: 鎮守河南中官劉郎乞皂隸，帝命予五十人。

translations.literal: The defending eunuch of Henan, Liu Lang, begged runner-slaves; the emperor ordered fifty given.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Lang, the garrison eunuch in Henan, asked for runner-slaves; the emperor granted fifty.

sentences.zh: 故事，尚書僅十二人，伸等力爭，詔止減二十人。

translations.literal: By precedent ministers of state had only twelve; Shen and others struggled hard, and the edict only reduced twenty.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent a ministry head received only twelve; Shen and his colleagues fought the grant, and the edict cut the number by twenty alone.

sentences.zh: 自後中官鹹援例陳乞，祖制遂壞。

translations.literal: From then on eunuchs all cited precedent in begging; ancestral regulations were thus broken.
translations.idiomatic: After that every eunuch cited precedent in begging favors, and the ancestral rules were undone.

sentences.zh: 伸居諫垣久，持議侃侃不撓，未及遷而卒。

translations.literal: Shen long held remonstrance posts, upheld his views frankly and unyielding, and died before further promotion.
translations.idiomatic: Shen served long on the remonstrance path, arguing his views with frank, unbending force, and died before he could rise higher.

sentences.zh: 王獻臣，字敬止，其先吳人，隸籍錦衣衛。

translations.literal: Wang Xianchen, styled Jingzhi; his forebears were men of Wu, registered in the Brocade Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xianchen, styled Jingzhi, was of Wu descent but registered in the Brocade Guard.

sentences.zh: 弘治六年舉進士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongzhi he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Hongzhi he passed the jinshi examinations.

sentences.zh: 授行人，擢御史。

translations.literal: Appointed courier, promoted to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed courier, then promoted to censor.

sentences.zh: 巡大同邊，請亟正諸將姚信、陳廣閉營避寇及馬昇、王杲、秦恭喪師罪，悉蠲大同、延綏旱傷逋賦，以寬軍民。

translations.literal: Inspecting the Datong frontier, he asked urgently to punish generals Yao Xin and Chen Guang for closing camp to flee bandits, and Ma Sheng, Wang Gao, and Qin Gong for losing armies, and wholly to remit overdue grain levies from drought damage in Datong and Yan-Sui, to ease military and civilian burdens.
translations.idiomatic: On inspection of the Datong frontier he urged swift punishment for Yao Xin and Chen Guang, who had shut their camps to avoid the raiders, and for Ma Sheng, Wang Gao, and Qin Gong, who had lost their commands; he also asked that drought-stricken arrears in Datong and Yan-Sui be wholly remitted to ease soldiers and civilians alike.

sentences.zh: 帝多從之。

translations.literal: The emperor largely followed him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor largely accepted his recommendations.

sentences.zh: 嘗令部卒導從遊山，為東廠緝事者所發，並言其擅委軍政官。

translations.literal: Once he had camp soldiers guide him on a mountain outing; it was exposed by Eastern Depot investigators, who also said he had on his own authority delegated military-government officials.
translations.idiomatic: Once he had camp soldiers escort him on a mountain outing; Eastern Depot agents exposed it and also accused him of appointing military and civil officers on his own authority.

sentences.zh: 征下詔獄，罪當輸贖。

translations.literal: Summoned to the imperial prison, the crime warranted pecuniary redemption.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to the imperial prison; by statute the offense allowed ransom.

sentences.zh: 特命杖三十，謫上杭丞。

translations.literal: Specially ordered thirty strokes of the cane and banished to Assistant of Shanghang.
translations.idiomatic: By special order he was beaten thirty strokes and demoted to assistant magistrate of Shanghang.

sentences.zh: 十七年，復以張天祥事被逮。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was again arrested over the Zhang Tianxiang affair.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was arrested again over the Zhang Tianxiang affair.

sentences.zh: 天祥者，遼東都指揮僉事斌孫也。

translations.literal: Tianxiang was grandson of Bin, Vice Commander of the Liaodong Regional Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxiang was the grandson of Bin, vice commander of the Liaodong Regional Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 斌以罪廢，天祥入粟得祖官。

translations.literal: Bin was dismissed for crime; Tianxiang bought grain-office entry to recover his grandfather's post.
translations.idiomatic: Bin had been dismissed for crime; Tianxiang purchased office through the grain quota and regained his grandfather's post.

sentences.zh: 有泰寧衛部十余騎射傷海西貢使，天祥出毛喇關掩殺他衛三十八人以歸，指為射貢使者。

translations.literal: More than ten riders of a Taining Guard band shot and wounded a Haixi tribute envoy; Tianxiang went out Mala Pass to ambush and kill thirty-eight men of another guard and returned, claiming them as the shooters of the tribute envoy.
translations.idiomatic: When more than ten riders from a Taining Guard band wounded a Haixi tribute envoy, Tianxiang slipped out through Mala Pass, ambushed thirty-eight men of another guard, and presented their heads as those of the attackers.

sentences.zh: 巡撫張鼐等奏捷，獻臣疑之。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Zhang Ding and others memorialized victory; Xianchen suspected it.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zhang Ding and others reported a victory; Xianchen was skeptical.

sentences.zh: 方移牒駁勘，會斌婦弟指揮張茂及子欽與天祥有郤，詐為前屯衛文書呈獻臣，具言劫營事。

translations.literal: Just as he was sending documents to rebut and investigate, it happened that Bin's wife's younger brother Commander Zhang Mao and son Qin bore a grudge against Tianxiang; they forged documents of the Qiantun Guard and presented them to Xianchen, fully setting forth the camp-looting affair.
translations.idiomatic: As he was dispatching documents to challenge and investigate the report, Bin's brother-in-law, Commander Zhang Mao, and Mao's son Qin—who bore a grudge against Tianxiang—forged Qiantun Guard papers and laid them before Xianchen, detailing a raid on the camp.

sentences.zh: 獻臣即以聞。

translations.literal: Xianchen at once reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Xianchen reported the matter at once.

sentences.zh: 未報，而獻臣被征。

translations.literal: Before reply came, Xianchen was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Before any answer came down, Xianchen himself was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 帝命大理丞吳一貫、錦衣指揮楊玉會新按臣余濂勘之，盡得其實。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Assistant Minister of Justice Wu Yiguan and Brocade Guard Commander Yang Yu, together with the newly assigned investigating commissioner Yu Lian, to investigate; they established the facts in full.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Assistant Minister of Justice Wu Yiguan and Brocade Guard Commander Yang Yu, together with the newly assigned investigating commissioner Yu Lian, to investigate; they established the facts in full.

sentences.zh: 斌等皆論死，天祥斃於獄。

translations.literal: Bin and the rest were all sentenced to death; Tianxiang died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Bin and the others were all sentenced to death; Tianxiang died in prison.

sentences.zh: 天祥叔父洪屢訟冤，帝密令東廠廉其事，還奏所勘皆誣。

translations.literal: Tianxiang's uncle Hong repeatedly sued for injustice; the emperor secretly ordered the Eastern Depot to investigate; they returned reporting the investigation was all false.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxiang's uncle Hong sued repeatedly for injustice; the emperor secretly ordered the Eastern Depot to look into it, and they reported that the prior investigation had been wholly false.

sentences.zh: 帝信之，欲盡反前獄，召內閣劉健等，出東廠揭帖示之，命盡逮一貫等會訊闕下。

translations.literal: The emperor believed it and wished wholly to reverse the prior case; he summoned the Grand Secretariat Liu Jian and others, produced the Eastern Depot's confidential memorandum for them to see, and ordered all to arrest Yiguan and the rest for joint inquiry below the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor believed them and meant to overturn the entire case; he summoned Liu Jian and the Grand Secretariat, showed them the Eastern Depot's confidential memorandum, and ordered Yiguan and the rest arrested for joint interrogation at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 健等言東廠揭帖不可行於外。

translations.literal: Jian and others said Eastern Depot confidential memoranda cannot be executed outside.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jian and his colleagues said an Eastern Depot memorandum could not be grounds for action in open court.

sentences.zh: 既退，復爭之。

translations.literal: After retiring they again contended.
translations.idiomatic: After they withdrew they argued the point again.

sentences.zh: 帝再召見，責健等。

translations.literal: The emperor again summoned them and reproached Jian and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned them back and rebuked Liu Jian and the others.

sentences.zh: 健對曰：「獄經法司讞，皆公卿士大夫，言足信。」

translations.literal: Jian replied: "The case has passed judicial review by the law offices; all are eminent ministers and literati—their words are fully trustworthy."
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jian answered: "The case has already been judged in the law offices by eminent ministers and scholars—their word should be trusted."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「法司斷獄不當，身且不保，言足信乎？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "When the law offices judge cases improperly they cannot even preserve themselves—are their words fully trustworthy?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "When the law offices misjudge a case they cannot even save their own skins—how can their word be trusted?"

sentences.zh: 謝遷曰：「事當從眾，若一二人言，安可信？」

translations.literal: Xie Qian said: "Matters ought to follow the multitude; if one or two persons speak, how can they be trusted?"
translations.idiomatic: Xie Qian said: "Such matters should rest on the many; if only one or two men speak, how can that be believed?"

sentences.zh: 健等又言眾證遠，不可悉逮。

translations.literal: Jian and the rest also said the many witnesses were distant and could not all be arrested.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jian and the others added that the witnesses were far scattered and could not all be brought in.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「此大獄，逮千人何恤。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "This is a great case—what is there to worry about in arresting a thousand?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "This is a great case—what does it matter if a thousand are seized?

sentences.zh: 茍功罪不明，邊臣孰肯效力者？」

translations.literal: If merit and crime are not clear, what frontier officer will be willing to exert himself?"
translations.idiomatic: If merit and guilt are left unclear, which frontier officer will dare give his all?"

sentences.zh: 健等再四爭執，見帝聲色厲，終不敢深言東廠非。

translations.literal: Jian and the rest contended four times more; seeing the emperor's voice and countenance stern, in the end they did not dare speak deeply of the Eastern Depot's wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jian and his colleagues argued again and again; seeing the emperor's voice harden and his face darken, they never dared press the Eastern Depot's fault to the end.

sentences.zh: 一貫等既至，帝親禦午門鞫之，欲抵一貫死。

translations.literal: When Yiguan and the rest had arrived, the emperor personally presided at the Meridian Gate to interrogate them and wished to charge Yiguan with death.
translations.idiomatic: When Yiguan and the others arrived, the emperor himself held court at the Meridian Gate to try them and meant to put Yiguan to death.

sentences.zh: 閔珪、載珊力救，乃謫嵩明州同知，獻臣廣東驛丞，濂雲南布政司照磨，茂父子論死，而斌免，洪反得論功。

translations.literal: Min Gui and Zai Shan fought to save them; Yiguan was demoted to assistant prefect of Songming, Xianchen to a Guangdong post station clerk, Yu Lian to registrar in the Yunnan provincial administration commission, and Mao and his son were sentenced to death—yet Bin was pardoned and Hong was rewarded for merit.
translations.idiomatic: Min Gui and Zai Shan fought to save them; Yiguan was demoted to assistant prefect of Songming, Xianchen to a Guangdong post station clerk, Yu Lian to registrar in the Yunnan provincial administration commission, and Mao and his son were sentenced to death—yet Bin was pardoned and Hong was rewarded for merit.

sentences.zh: 武宗立，獻臣遷永嘉知縣。

translations.literal: When Wuzong acceded, Xianchen was transferred to Magistrate of Yongjia.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wuzong took the throne, Xianchen was appointed magistrate of Yongjia.

sentences.zh: 吳一貫，字道夫，海陽人。

translations.literal: Wu Yiguan, styled Daofu, was a native of Haiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yiguan, styled Daofu, came from Haiyang.

sentences.zh: 成化十七年進士。

translations.literal: A presented scholar in the seventeenth year of Chenghua.
translations.idiomatic: He became a presented scholar in the seventeenth year of Chenghua (1481).

sentences.zh: 由上高知縣擢御史。

translations.literal: From Magistrate of Shanggao he was promoted to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from magistrate of Shanggao to censor.

sentences.zh: 弘治中，歷按浙江、福建、南畿，以強幹聞。

translations.literal: In the Hongzhi period, successively investigated Zhejiang, Fujian, and the southern capital region, and was known for strong capability.
translations.idiomatic: During Hongzhi he served in turn as investigating censor in Zhejiang, Fujian, and the southern capital region, and was known as a forceful administrator.

sentences.zh: 擢大理右寺丞。

translations.literal: Promoted to Assistant Minister of the Right Court of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to assistant minister of the right court of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 畿輔、河南饑，請發粟二十萬石以振，又別請二萬石給京邑及昌平民。

translations.literal: When the capital region and Henan suffered famine, he asked to issue two hundred thousand dan of grain for relief, and separately asked twenty thousand dan for the capital districts and Changping commoners.
translations.idiomatic: When famine struck the capital region and Henan, he asked that two hundred thousand dan of grain be released for relief, and another twenty thousand dan for the capital suburbs and the people of Changping.

sentences.zh: 既謫官，正德初，遷江西副使。

translations.literal: After demotion, at the beginning of Zhengde he was moved to Vice Commissioner of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: After his demotion, at the start of Zhengde he was appointed vice commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 討華林賊有功，進按察使。

translations.literal: Suppressing Hualin bandits with merit, he was advanced to surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned successfully against the Hualin bandits and was promoted to surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 行軍至奉新卒，士民立忠節祠祀焉。

translations.literal: On campaign he reached Fengxin and died; soldiers and common people erected a Loyal-Martyrs shrine to sacrifice to him.
translations.idiomatic: On campaign he reached Fengxin and died; soldiers and civilians raised a shrine of loyal martyrdom in his honor.

sentences.zh: 余濂，字宗周，都昌人。

translations.literal: Yu Lian, styled Zongzhou, was a native of Duchang.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Lian, styled Zongzhou, came from Duchang.

sentences.zh: 弘治六年進士。

translations.literal: Jinshi in the sixth year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the sixth year of Hongzhi.

sentences.zh: 武宗時，終雲南副使。

translations.literal: Under Wuzong, he ended as Vice Commissioner of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Wuzong he ended his career as vice commissioner of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 孝宗勵精圖治，委任大臣，中官勢稍絀。

translations.literal: Xiaozong strove to refine governance and entrusted great ministers; eunuch power was somewhat curbed.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong labored to refine governance and entrusted his great ministers; eunuch influence was somewhat checked.

sentences.zh: 而張天祥及滿倉兒事皆發自東廠，廷議猶為所撓雲。

translations.literal: Yet the Zhang Tianxiang and Mancang'er affairs both arose from the Eastern Depot, and court deliberation was still swayed by it.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Zhang Tianxiang and Mancang'er affairs both sprang from the Eastern Depot, and court debate was still bent by it.

sentences.zh: 滿倉兒事，具《孫磐傳》。

translations.literal: The Mancang'er affair is fully treated in the 《Biography of Sun Pan》.
translations.idiomatic: The Mancang'er affair is set forth in full in the 《Biography of Sun Pan》.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：御史為朝廷耳目，而給事中典章奏，得爭是非於廷陛間，皆號稱「言路」。

translations.literal: The appraiser's comment: Censors are the court's eyes and ears, while supervising secretaries manage memorials and can dispute right and wrong between the court steps—both are styled the "remonstrance path."
translations.idiomatic: The historian comments: Censors are the eyes and ears of the throne; supervising secretaries handle memorials and may dispute right and wrong upon the court steps—together they are called the "path of speech."

sentences.zh: 天順以後居其職者，振風裁而恥緘默。

translations.literal: After Tianshun those holding these posts stirred moral authority and were ashamed of silence.
translations.idiomatic: After the Tianshun reign those who held these posts roused moral authority and were ashamed to stay silent.

sentences.zh: 自天子、大臣、左右近習無不指斥極言。

translations.literal: From the Son of Heaven, great ministers, and intimate attendants at his side, none escaped pointed reproach and utmost speech.
translations.idiomatic: None were spared—not the Son of Heaven, not great ministers, not those at his side—from pointed rebuke spoken to the limit.

sentences.zh: 南北交章，連名列署。

translations.literal: North and south exchanged memorials, linking names in joint signatures.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials flew from north and south, names chained together in joint petitions.

sentences.zh: 或遭譴謫，則大臣抗疏論救，以為美談。

translations.literal: If some suffered reprimand or banishment, great ministers submitted opposing memorials to argue rescue—a matter held up as fine talk.
translations.idiomatic: When one was censured or exiled, grand ministers would file rescue memorials—a gesture praised as noble conduct.

sentences.zh: 顧其時門戶未開，名節自勵，未嘗有承意指於政府，效搏噬於權珰，如末季所為者。

translations.literal: Yet in that time factional doors had not opened, name and integrity were self-enforced; never was there currying favor and pointing at the government, or imitating biting and tearing at powerful eunuchs, as in the late age.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in that age factions had not yet opened their doors; men disciplined their own honor and never curried favor with the government or snapped at powerful eunuchs as in the dynasty's last years.

sentences.zh: 故其言有當有不當，而其心則公。

translations.literal: Therefore their words had what was fitting and what was not, but their hearts were public-minded.
translations.idiomatic: So their words sometimes hit the mark and sometimes missed, but their hearts were for the public good.

sentences.zh: 上者愛國，次亦愛名。

translations.literal: The highest loved the state; next they also loved reputation.
translations.idiomatic: The best among them loved the realm; the next rank loved their good name.

sentences.zh: 然論國事而至於愛名，則將惟其名之可取，而事之得失有所不顧，於匡弼之道或者其未善乎。

translations.literal: Yet when discussing state affairs one comes to loving reputation, then one will seek only what is creditable in name, while gain and loss of affairs will in part be neglected—in the way of aiding and correcting, perhaps this is not yet good?
translations.idiomatic: Yet when counsel on state affairs turns into love of reputation, a man may chase only what sounds honorable and let the gain or loss of the matter go unattended—in the art of aiding the throne, can that be called perfect?
